sound_class_options_source: registered classes bound to native events in L44_BULK_POOL/source_manifest.json
notes: qa15_*: the ordinary judge keeps the 0.2 m net-change margin but allows a 15 cm / 40 % counter-trend excursion; the research default of 5 cm refused a 25 cm approach with an 8.5 cm wobble (0035, 2026-09-12).
keep_scene_when_target_unmet: a capture that misses its requested pixel condition continues to audio and delivery for the other question types; the requested target stays unmet.
accept_observed_branches: a measured legal branch is kept as measured; the requested branch is a preference, not a gate.
